description: Holds stock request details records, linked to products, stock request header.
business_purpose: Used to track and report stock request details records, including amounts and quantities, for the Factory & Inventory area.
record_granularity: One row represents one stock request detail.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the stock request detail.

columns.name: request_headerid
columns.description: Reference to the stock request header linked to this stock request detail.

columns.name: productid
columns.description: Reference to the products linked to this stock request detail.

columns.name: product_name_type
columns.description: Product name type of the stock request detail.

columns.name: size
columns.description: Size of the stock request detail.

columns.name: grade
columns.description: Grade of the stock request detail.

columns.name: thickeness
columns.description: Thickeness of the stock request detail.

columns.name: product_wise_notional_area
columns.description: Product wise notional area of the stock request detail.

columns.name: qty
columns.description: Qty of the stock request detail.

columns.name: total_amount
columns.description: Total amount of the stock request detail.

columns.name: total_weight
columns.description: Total weight of the stock request detail.

columns.name: beforeqty
columns.description: Beforeqty of the stock request detail.

relationships.description: Each stock request detail references one stock request header (request header).
Each stock request detail references one products (product).

business_rules: Use total_amount / total_weight for monetary or quantity totals.
Columns product_name_type classify the record; check the distinct values before filtering on them.
Join to Products, Stock Request Header through the foreign key columns to resolve names.

common_metrics.name: Average Product Wise Notional Area per stock request detail

common_queries: Stock Request Details by stock request header
Stock Request Details count by product name type
Top stock request header by product wise notional area

known_issues: product_wise_notional_area, total_amount, total_weight are stored as floating point, so sums can carry small rounding differences.
product_wise_notional_area, beforeqty are nullable; use COALESCE when summing or comparing.

query_notes: The database is MySQL/MariaDB; use MySQL syntax and the exact name StockRequestDetails (identifiers can be case-sensitive).
Use COUNT(DISTINCT id) when counting stock request detail records; joins can duplicate rows.
Use SUM(total_amount) for totals of total amount.
To resolve names, join on: request_headerid = StockRequestHeader.id; productid = Products.id.
